title: EP60023: Micro-Financing The Grassroots Sector
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Micro-Financing the Grassroots Sector (EP 60023) Salient features of micro
finance, benefits and target groups, Understand the scope and potential of
micro-finance, Active micro-finance by potential organizations, Micro-finance
models and characteristics, designing micro-finance program- client
identification, Credit Institutions-rural credit, Types of rural institutions,
self Help Groups (SHGs) and generation of savings
